concept: Step Functions: Lambda orchestration with branching and retries
tests: Choosing a service to coordinate multiple Lambdas with branching, retries and error handling.
expected: AWS Step Functions — state machine with Choice, Retry, Catch. Triggers: "coordinate multiple Lambda functions", "branching, retries, error handling", "maintainable".
why_not: SQS only queues; EventBridge routes events but does not keep workflow state; a monolithic Lambda — complex and limited to 15 min.
